description: Add the agent’s EIP-712 signature to a queued request. Needs MYMULTISIG_PRIVATE_KEY for an owner. Refuses if any existing signature is invalid. Only call after showing get_request output to the user and getting confirmation.

chainId.description: EVM chain id, e.g. 11155111 for Sepolia (see list_networks)

name: approve_request
title: Approve (sign) a request
